question: {The HCF of } (1)/(2), (3)/(4), (27)/(16) { and } (81)/(64) { is:}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Formula: HCF of fractions = HCF(Numerators) ÷ LCM(Denominators)

Numerators are 1, 3, 27, 81 → HCF is 1

Denominators are 2, 4, 16, 64 → LCM is 64 (since 2, 4, 16 are factors of 64)

HCF = 1/64

**∴ The correct answer is 1/64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Fractions are 1/2, 3/4, 27/16, and 81/64.

Formula Used: HCF of (a/b, c/d, e/f) = HCF(a, c, e) / LCM(b, d, f)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2eeb005499d7b8a50cbfb19c2c3a304c34a76bd9a320b7e04c036daf790f1c5.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Find HCF of numerators {1, 3, 27, 81}

⇒ Factors of 1 = 1

⇒ Factors of 3 = 1, 3

⇒ Factors of 27 = 1, 3, 9, 27

⇒ Factors of 81 = 1, 3, 9, 27, 81

⇒ Common factor is 1 ∴ HCF = 1

⇒ Step 2: Find LCM of denominators {2, 4, 16, 64}

⇒ 2 = 2¹ | 4 = 2² | 16 = 2⁴ | 64 = 2⁶

⇒ LCM = 2⁶ = 64

⇒ Required HCF = 1/64

**∴ The correct answer is 1/64.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM of Fractions

The LCM of fractions is calculated as: LCM of Fractions = LCM(Numerators) ÷ HCF(Denominators).

Simplification Rule

Always simplify fractions to their simplest form (coprime numerators and denominators) before calculating HCF or LCM.

HCF × LCM Property

For any two numbers A and B, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: A × B = HCF(A,B) × LCM(A,B).

HCF of Co-prime Numbers

If a set of numbers includes the number 1 or any two numbers that are co-prime, the HCF of the entire set is always 1.
